description: M1's ambient traffic: which hulls each culture flies in each traffic role (a catalog faction line and size class), and each population tier's weight in the gravity model that sets the flows between ports. The Ironhulls (miners) fly their civilian line: Tinhauls, Brasshauls and Ironhauls (classes I, III and IV). Rates, shares and speeds are core params (core/src/world.rs).
